emulator_check.method: Emulator = coarse surrogate skyline (step17 settings: 180 bins, 5 m step to 3 km, 80 m beyond) + Gaussian-process correction of the full-minus-coarse hourly margins over position (Matern 5/2, 81-cell training grid, LOO-selected). Window metrics from emulated hourly flags with the cube window helper. Candidates ranked by emulated 12-month Sun % on a 12.5 m lattice; the top picks and random lattice points re-checked with the full solver on all 21 maps.
emulator_check.caveat: SURROGATE for search only: rank and error from the re-check, nominal map, mast 1 m; it is not a solver and its numbers are not results. Re-checked values are full-solver geometry, SOURCE-BASED · UNVALIDATED.

sd.label: Sun %: standard deviation over the grid

closure.label: sum of ANOVA terms / variance (1 = exact)

sobol__centre__sun_pct.method: Exact functional ANOVA (Sobol / Hoeffding) on the full factorial grid of the cube, equal weight per axis level: V_u from Moebius inclusion-exclusion of marginal means; first-order S_i = V_i/V, total ST_i = sum over u containing i of V_u/V, Shapley Sh_i = sum over u containing i of V_u/(|u| V). science/cube/sensitivity.py. Source: Centre: terrain map x mast height x hourly start (12 months) (centre_mast_schedule.json.gz); axes T, D_mast, S.
sobol__centre__sun_pct.caveat: Share of spread within this scenario set: every axis level is weighted equally and the 20 terrain clones are samples (deterministic PGDA 78 error realizations), so the indices describe this grid, not the population of possible terrains. Not a probability; not a ranking of physical importance outside the ranges on the axes.

sobol__energy__mean_power_w.method: Exact functional ANOVA (Sobol / Hoeffding) on the full factorial grid of the cube, equal weight per axis level: V_u from Moebius inclusion-exclusion of marginal means; first-order S_i = V_i/V, total ST_i = sum over u containing i of V_u/V, Shapley Sh_i = sum over u containing i of V_u/(|u| V). science/cube/sensitivity.py. Source: Energy margin: map x array x mast x daily start (ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION) (energy.json.gz); axes T, D_array, D_mast, S.
sobol__energy__mean_power_w.caveat: Share of spread within this scenario set: every axis level is weighted equally and the 20 terrain clones are samples (deterministic PGDA 78 error realizations), so the indices describe this grid, not the population of possible terrains. Not a probability; not a ranking of physical importance outside the ranges on the axes.
